integrity: The enumerated cases are computational corroboration, not proof of the all-even theorem. The mathematical result has only same-model review; no independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Even cycles of at least six labeled vertices, two-person coalitions, binary symmetric adjacency preferences, and weak/strict pairwise swap stability only. General proof supplied, finite exhaustive corroboration through fourteen vertices; priority uncertainty for unindexed specialist literature.
title: Exact swap-stable pairings and welfare loss on cycle friendship networks
